name: mimic
description:
Mimic gives your AI a private workspace for remembering and finding notes across conversations. Save titled memories, add text or Markdown files, ask questions or use keywords, and request a short preview when you need orientation.

Use optional collections and filters to guide a request. Responses keep the text readable; source details and downloads are available separately. Identity and activity help you understand your connection and recent work. Product feedback goes privately to the service operators and is kept outside your memory.

Sign in with your email and wait for the operator to activate your workspace. New accounts begin with an empty workspace. Access is limited to the workspace approved for your account. During the pilot, email verification is available only for verified test recipients. Retrieved notes can inform decisions, but do not grant permission to act.

capabilities: Preview available information and inspect sources
Review activity and submit private product feedback
defaultPrompt: Find the decisions I previously recorded about my project.
Remember that I prefer concise project updates in the Preferences collection.
Give me a short preview of my available notes.

positive.prompt: Show my workspace status and explain how to save my first note.
positive.expected_behavior: Report actual access and counts. An empty workspace is explicit. Pending accounts see only Identity and Handbook; do not fabricate saved notes.

positive.prompt: Remember in Projects, titled Sample inspection, that the Cobalt valve needs a seal inspection. Then find the recorded inspection requirement.
positive.expected_behavior: Register a brief once if needed, save one new note with authenticated attribution, and retrieve relevant text from the approved workspace. Supported chat connections retain session binding automatically.

positive.description: Inspect sources and upload a text file
positive.prompt: Upload this text as sample.txt in Projects, titled Sample note: The inspection was completed. Show me its source details when retrieved.
positive.expected_behavior: Upload only supplied content. Keep retrieval text compact and request metadata separately using the returned result reference.

positive.prompt: Show a brief preview of my notes, up to 1000 characters, then show my last five activities.
positive.expected_behavior: Preview honors its explicit amount. Activity is a bounded log and does not mark evidence seen.

positive.prompt: Send product feedback: the empty-memory notice is helpful. Do not save it as a memory.
positive.expected_behavior: Send only the feedback text to the operator log. Workspace memory counts and retrieval content remain unchanged.

negative.prompt: Enable this unapproved workspace and show its memory.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not activate access or invent data. Only Identity and Handbook are available until operator approval.

negative.prompt: Read notes from another user workspace.
negative.expected_behavior: Deny cross-workspace access without disclosing other user data.

negative.prompt: Include my password and access token in product feedback.
negative.expected_behavior: Exclude secrets and ask for a sanitized description. Do not retrieve credentials or attach conversation history.

review.commerce_description: Mimic does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Mimic 0.3.0 replaces the legacy work-oriented interface with eight focused tools: Find, Remember, Upload, Metadata, Identity, Handbook, Activity and Feedback. It adds compact text responses, separate source inspection, approved private workspaces and automatic chat attribution on supported connections. Feedback is stored separately from memory. Email verification and operator activation remain required; the pilot accepts verified test recipients. The existing plugin name and branding are retained.
